scope: Fresh native macOS GUI acquisition with generated Rekkefly demo input, natural experiment completion, recording-library discovery, independent recorder close/collection, and linked pose/video replay. This is software integration QA, not physical-animal or display-timing validation.

player.fingerprintScope: Prepared non-Editor C# files under Assets, sorted path-to-SHA256 compact JSON; packages, scenes and settings are outside this fingerprint.

fixes.behavior: Finalized recording sessions reject late logger and sidecar writes.
Independent Mac recorder clean exits use Darwin wait status; failed, killed and unverifiable exits remain pending.

recordingLibrary.postCollectionSummaryBehavior: Media collection changes recording metadata; the library rescans rather than trusting a stale finalized summary.

linkedReplay.associationMeaning: Recorded software-consumed tracker frame identity and source-clock timestamp; not a hardware exposure or LED presentation timestamp.

recordedDashboard.styledDashboardFinalVisualStatus: Pending final root walkthrough; not counted as validated here.

validationLimits: Computer-control window routing was intermittent and required restarts and CLI replay bootstrapping before returning to the GUI library. A seamless uninterrupted walkthrough is not claimed.
No physical camera, animal, multi-monitor setup or LED scanout was validated in this fresh-run exercise.
No Windows or Linux player walkthrough was performed for these changes.
No new 300-reload endurance result is claimed. Earlier frozen-release Editor endurance evidence has its own report.
The cause of the historical Unity scene-reset crash has not been established.
Nominal video frame rate and pose wall-clock spans are not measured hardware exposure or stimulus timing.
